ood_dataset: LungHist700 (Tabatabaei et al. 2024) - pulmonary histopathology, 20x subset
image_encoder: PLIP ViT-B/32 (vinid/plip, frozen, no LC25000 supervision)
text_encoder: PLIP CLIP text encoder (frozen, no LC25000 supervision)
classification_rule: argmax cosine(image, class-prompt) restricted to LC25000-mappable classes
